prerequisites: You have already started as a student-entrepreneur and/or you are ready to expand your business.
You work on your business, not just in your business.
Admission is granted after an intake moment with student-entrepreneur coaches from Startpunt Ondernemen.

learning_outcomes.text: You build an entrepreneurial network. (fellow student-entrepreneurs, coach, mentor entrepreneur, entrepreneurs from external entrepreneurial networks)
The setup of your company is clear and you set realistic entrepreneurial goals.
You convert your ideas into action (planning, organizing, monitoring), ensure that your plans become reality and that you launch your company.

You gain entrepreneurial skills in practice and share this with your fellow student-entrepreneurs. (for example: sales & negotiation, customer relations & partnerships, smart deals, increasing customer base, organizing yourself more efficiently, making decisions, marketing yourself, managing finances, dealing with uncertainties, growing as an entrepreneur…)

syllabus_topics: Expanding entrepreneurial network by finding a mentor entrepreneur, joining an external entrepreneurial network and participating in activities, and joining an entrepreneurship competition.
Building an entrepreneurial community, co-shaping the agenda and expanding and sharing know-how and expertise, involving external professionals and/or entrepreneurs.
Examples of entrepreneurial themes: increasing customer base, better financial insight, how to market your company, pricing, organizing your company more efficiently.
Creating a growth plan that formulates ambitions, challenges, and action plan, which is monitored and adjusted throughout the year.
Receiving targeted feedback and tools to strengthen entrepreneurial skills.
Examples of skills: sales, negotiation, customer relations, financial transactions, self-confidence as an entrepreneur, dealing with uncertainties, making decisions.
teaching_methods: Participation in the Thomas More entrepreneurship competition
Participation in at least three external entrepreneurial activities (e.g., external entrepreneurial network, Startpunt Ondernemen activities, or entrepreneurial programs/pitch events)
assessment_rules: The goal of this evaluation is to give student-entrepreneurs maximum space to demonstrate their results in/to their company and to visualize their learning path as an entrepreneur. There is no second examination opportunity for this OPO. However, it can be requested to the lecturers to do the evaluation planned in EP2 in EP3, if there are valid reasons for this. For example, if you sell sunscreen, the summer period may have a crucial impact on the entrepreneurial goals and actions you have set. There are no partial transfers for this course.
